fixed: Same 144 sealed source frames, 58 recording groups, native D candidate indices and reference verification. Same initial and enriched held-recording partitions. Source checkpoint, sampling, RGB, box geometry and score readout are frozen. No target or FINAL access.
supervision: Store owner, ternary expression match, and ternary single-instance validity separately. Retain positive and negative labels from uniquely assigned source entities. Dense source reference must have at least six uniquely assigned points. Add a negative only for an ownership-unknown high-score candidate that contains at least three sampled points, has zero points uniquely assigned to the reference, and is strictly spatially disjoint from its upright reference box expanded by 20% plus a 0.2 m margin on each side. Use separating rectangle/height axes directly, not an IoU round-off. Retain possible partial and mixed reference overlaps as unknown. True candidates are never given new negatives. Use no score threshold as label evidence.
shortlist: Candidates are generated only by the frozen exact pooled D, old aligned pair and earlier complete-pool scoring. Review every unassigned actual winner among these three readouts plus the leading unassigned near-winner if one occurs among their Top-3 and no unassigned winner was nominated. The initial selection may use model scores. Case imagery uses anonymous random order and shows no score or method.
visual_audit: Check a bounded score-blind component with candidate and verified-reference projections. Source ownership is inherited. A visually established single-object or invalid/mixed region may receive an independent ternary validity label, never a new identity unless the fixed 3D evidence supports exclusion. Unevaluated validity stays unknown.
A: Exact earlier pool_centered three-scalar readout and known-entity full-pool ranking. Retain earlier validated objective, bounds, and per-fold fitting behavior.
B: Same three scalars and A's loss, weights, bounds, solver, sampling and candidate pool. The sole change is adding known reference_match=negative candidates with owner=-1 to the masked ranking denominator without merging unknown identities. Retain all positive groups and don't put uncertified candidates in the denominator.
C: Reinitialize the prior 10240-parameter rank-16 text/local appearance head and exact old frozen role-token, local 288-d point and 64-d calibrated R76 image foreground-minus-collar features. Fit with the same B candidate labels and max-per-entity loss, adding its bounded score to the same fitted B base. Prior learning rate, weight decay, 16 epochs, fixed seed and batch size.
D: Same small head and train budget as C. Keep its frozen point and role-token evidence, use 32 low-frequency coefficients of the old aligned image vector plus 24 source-pixel foreground-minus-collar color histogram values and 8 relative geometry values against the original frozen subject winner. Read these new physical features with the same head and label protocol. Match C's availability criterion. Test RGB disabled and candidate-permuted RGB of equal statistics while preserving each candidate's point and geometry features.
negative_controls: D includes the same-head RGB off and candidate-permuted controls. For held-out rejection, use identical frozen actual-winner features with old and augmented expression labels to isolate availability of certified erroneous winners.
safety_gate: Before joint research require the locked evidence arm to exceed raw D and matched C/B and shuffled-RGB counterparts for pooled Waymo full-pool identity count and MRR, with no regression of correctly selected references on either source panel and no lower correct acceptance under the tested winner verifier. If unsupported keep R158+PCA and do not launch a joint or six-direction target run.
